summary: Tested Stripe Checkout (TEST mode) deposit integration end-to-end. Backend: 9 new tests in test_stripe_deposit.py (checkout session for demo-ana $1,945 -> checkout.stripe.com URL + cs_test_ id + payment_transactions record; 400 for contract_sent lead; 404 bad token; 422 missing origin_url; status endpoint returns only session_id/status/payment_status; unknown session 404; old /deposit/pay 404/405; webhook bad/missing signature 400; dev advance from pending_deposit -> deposit_received and checkout then 400). Updated old regression test that used removed /deposit/pay. All 27 pass serially. UI at 390px: deposit screen shows 'Pay deposit $1,945' + 4242 test note; redirect to Stripe; paid with 4242 card -> back to /w/demo-ana?session_id=... -> done screen 'You're booked, Ana.'; DB payment method=stripe, reference=session id, tx completed/paid with payment_intent; real Stripe webhooks hitting /api/stripe/webhook return 200; dashboard row shows Ana Pereira 'Deposit received'. Confirming screen verified with an unpaid session_id. Fresh TEST_ lead created via /dev, advanced to pending_deposit, paid via Stripe ($1,050 = 5% of $21,000) -> done. Cancel flow: return to deposit screen worked BUT 'Payment cancelled' toast never appeared -> RCA'd and fixed (see rca). Data reset via /api/dev/reset at end.

minor.issue: origin_url is taken from the client unvalidated and used for success_url/cancel_url; anyone can mint a Stripe session that redirects to an arbitrary domain. Validate against an allowed origin (e.g. env FRONTEND origin).
Every click creates a new Stripe session + 'initiated' payment_transactions row (7 orphan rows observed for one lead). Consider reusing an open session or expiring old ones.
Tax fallback path drops billing_address_collection='required', so only country+ZIP are collected (expected given sandbox has no head office address, just noting).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe Checkout hosted page automation: fill #email, open card accordion via JS click on [data-testid=card-accordion-item-button] (normal click is intercepted), then #cardNumber/#cardExpiry/#cardCvc/#billingName/#billingCountry/#billingPostalCode, uncheck #enableStripePass, click [data-testid=hosted-payment-submit-button]. Cancel = a[href*='payment=cancelled'] (JS click). Webhook usually finalizes before redirect so the confirming screen flashes too fast to catch; test it by navigating to ?session_id=<unpaid id>. Backend tests share one DB and both modules call /dev/reset: with the default xdist -n 2 they occasionally race (test_start_agent failed once); run with -n 0 for deterministic results.
rca of the issue: Cancel toast missing: sonner 2.0.3 ToastState only delivers to current subscribers. In App.js <Toaster> was rendered after <Routes>, so React ran PortalPage's mount useEffect (toast('Payment cancelled')) before Toaster's subscribe effect -> toast dropped. Repro: open /w/demo-ana?payment=cancelled -> URL cleared but no toast. Fix: render <Toaster> before <Routes> in App.js. Verified via real Stripe back link: toast 'Payment cancelled / Your deposit is still due whenever you're ready.' shows and deposit screen remains.
